about_the_game:
FEAR FA 98 is an arcade soccer game with a blood soaked twist. Play alone (in the dark) or in a horrendously violent  two players match up!  Combines the competitive elements of the soccer world with classic horror tropes that made series like Silent Hill or Manhunt great. Play against the computer, or massacre your friends on a terrifying afternoon worthy of the '90s 

FEAR FA 98 is an arcade soccer throwback that aims to create fast-paced and dynamic matches of 90’s youth. Choose your team, each with exclusive weapons and demonic summons, to shred your opponents. During the match, the pitch itself works against you, with monsters and traps appearing to make the game more interesting.  

But don’t worry, you’re players aren’t helpless so feel free use a myriad weapons to drain the opposing team's strength. Wield axes, stab with syringes, and most dangerous of all, run with scissors.  

And of course, you can always summon ancient demons to aid in your brutal ball based battle! 

Enjoy the first horror game to combine soccer simulation with terror: A unique blend of soccer gameplay with horror elements. 

  • Wield weapons during matches: Players can use knives, axes, and firearms while competing on the field. 

  • Summon Demons: Soccer brings out the worst in some people. Use this darkness to summon demonic creatures to attack opponents and alter the course of the game. 

  • Dangerous Stadiums: Navigate fields filled with traps, monsters, and hidden dangers that affect the flow of the match. 

  • Multiplayer Modes: Supports 2 players local multiplayer mode, allowing competitive gameplay and retro feelings of warmth and incandescent rage. 

  • Story Mode: Uncover the intricate and thrilling horror story behind FEAR FA 98 and its connection to the Jacob Jazz universe, where the Earth is ravaged by beings that humanity will soon discover have been living inside the sun for years 


    FEAR FA 98 proudly presents some of the official teams competing in our tournaments and leagues, but remember that you can also create your own online by combining the players that best fit your play style! 

    • Sectarians: Players who strongly follow the beliefs or practices of a particular sect, often to the point of exclusion or hostility toward those outside their group. In extreme cases, sectarianism can lead to violence or conflict, especially when tied to religious or ideological divides. 

    • Serial Killers: Individuals who commit a series of murders, typically following a distinct pattern or method. These killers often have psychological motives and may target specific types of victims. 

    • Psychopathic Nurses: Nurses who exhibit psychopathic traits—such as lack of empathy, manipulativeness, or violent tendencies—while working in healthcare. Some have used their positions of trust to harm patients, making them particularly dangerous. 

    • & many more!

reviews:
“Jazz's "horror arcade soccer simulator" is an unrepentant patchwork of ghoulish influences. It's a motley crew of influences on a wildly adventurous game, careless of genre constraints and determined to carve out its own niche.”
PC Gamer

“Survival horror clatters into soccer royalty as "Silent Hill mixed with FIFA 98" I could never have imagined would work this well”
GamesRadar+

“Exactly the kind of game I probably would have owned as a kid, and one I still yearn to own now.”
Digital Trends
short_description: FEAR FA 98: Silent Hill mixed with FIFA 98. Use your enemies' heads as the ball, use knives, and summon demons! the very first survival horror soccer simulator!. Play against the computer, or the classic local mode to enjoy with your friends on a terrifying afternoon worthy of the '90s.
